Fisherman's Coast adds seven places to explore.
A fisherman's cottage, a harbour pier, a lighthouse, a stilt shack, an ice fishing camp, a river boathouse.
And a sunken trawler, full of loot.
Crab pots fish for you, even while you're AFK.
Bait makes them faster and luckier.
And messages in a bottle can lead to treasure.
It's free on Fabric, Neo-Forge and Forge.
Send this to your fishing buddy.
